name: soffice
description: LibreOffice headless — renders a .pptx/.docx/.odp to PDF or PNG so a slide can be checked by eye (the deck under presentations/ is verified this way).
usage: soffice --headless --convert-to pdf --outdir .isekai/tmp/<scratch> <file.pptx>   # then read the PDF page; --convert-to png renders page 1 only. Writes a .~lock.* beside the source while open (gitignored).

name: docker
description: Container runtime on this machine — builds and runs images; a network pull or a push is an outward act and needs Veldora's agreement (Nature 7).
usage: docker build -t <tag> . · docker run --rm <tag> · docker compose up   # pulls reach the network: ask first (Nature 7).

name: ollama
description: Local embedding/LLM server — canon/memory-tiers.md's engine step 1 (nomic-embed-text, ~274 MB, offline after one pull). NOT installed on this machine; installing it and pulling a model are outward acts that need Veldora's consent (Nature 7).
usage: Not installed. If consented: install ollama, `ollama pull nomic-embed-text`, then memory.js's engine step 1 applies (canon/memory-tiers.md).
